## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2f28692062b3ededad20765415ff4c4d7b7d5c90`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #20957 (body; comments 5921125191 claim, 5921492175 os-dev-report), PR #20967 (body, 4-file list, API diff — byte-equal to the seat's `pr.diff`), the head's check-runs (two polls, 23:2xZ and 23:35:37Z), and the repository at the head and at `origin/main` (`d7b981769`; merge-base with the head `3693a1b50`, as the report states). `git diff origin/main...head` equals the API diff; a two-dot diff against current `main` is identical for the four files, and no judged file (`SKILL.md`, `execution-duties.md`, `triage-duties.md`, `ensure-pm-labels.sh`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` rule 3, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `check-half-states.mjs`) moved on `main` since the merge-base (the one `NORTH-STAR.md` commit since, `c1602ba42`, adds a feature line at :43; the 优先级 block is byte-identical at merge-base, main and head).

**Check-runs on the head (35 at 23:35:37Z): 22 success · 11 skipped · 1 in_progress · 1 failure.**
- `Lint & Repo Gates` 110142731828 — **in_progress** (started 23:22:18Z). Per `.github/workflows/lint.yml` at the head this is the job that runs `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (:925), `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (:933), `check:pm-label-desc-cap` (:946), `check:pm-half-states` (:1270), `check:pm-governed-prose` (:1607) and `check:skill-frame-sync` (:5626) — the load-bearing derived families for this diff. Not concluded at review time; this record's mechanical pins in ①(f) were read off the head directly and agree with what that job measures, but its conclusion is CI's to give, and the landing waits for it.
- `Check Changeset` 110142726303 — **failure**, suite 99647239023, 23:22:18Z → 23:24:14Z: predates the `skip-changeset` label. The same job on the same head, 110144053166, suite 99648333290, ran at 23:27:00Z and is `skipped` (PR `updated_at` 23:27:01Z). The failure is stale; the later run governs.
- Everything else `success` or `skipped`, including `Governed Surface Queue Guard` 110142726584 (the one CI-only family the report names), the four card/branch/single-writer guards, `Test Core` 1–6 (1/6 completed success at 23:32:51Z, after the first poll) and the four `Type Check` jobs.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff edits governed Tier S rule text: three files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` at net 0 lines each, plus one comment block in `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` (+5/−4, every changed line begins with `#`). The ruling executed is the maintainer's three messages, quoted verbatim in the card body and the PR body; each statement the diff makes or removes is judged against them and against the repository.

**(a) `execution-duties.md:22` deleted whole** — 「舰队至多一张 `tooling` 卡带 `pm:dispatched`,第二张等;带 `Unblocks:` 者继承产品级不计数。」 Message 2 (「或者简单点,直接撤掉这个规矩,只要优先派高优先级的卡片就可以」) retires the slot; the first half and the 「不计数」 of the second half die with it. The priority inheritance of an `Unblocks:` card is verified to have homes the seats read, at `main` and unchanged at the head: `docs/NORTH-STAR.md:115` rule 3 「…解锁产品 P0/P1 的仪器卡沿链继承其优先级。」 (the line `execution-duties.md:44` orders every take to re-read: 「每次取卡现读」); `execution-duties.md:43` (head numbering) 「阻塞项在飞 ⇒ 等:…;p0/p1 优先级沿链传递。」; `references/dispatch-runbook.md:162` 「父卡 p0/p1 ⇒ 阻塞卡同笔升同级,沿链重复。」. The card's item 1 condition ("if both carry it, the whole line goes") holds; no rule was lost. Observation only: the deleted clause said 「继承产品级」 at any level, the surviving homes state it for P0/P1; at p2/p3 the inheritance had no effect the take-order does not already give, since triage grades the instrument card by NORTH-STAR rules 1–3 and 标签序 ranks by the card's own label. Not a loss.

**(b) The new `execution-duties.md:45` and the rewritten `triage-duties.md:64`** — 「开放 = 未派发(无 `pm:dispatched`、无 assignee);在飞的 P0/P1 不挡任何候选,只余取卡全序。」 and 「所入车道队列 P0/P1 开着(= 未派发,在飞不算)时,无解锁对象的 p2/p3 `tooling` 卡同样关。」 Both execute message 1 (「…但p0p1已经在开发中时,不应该卡住其他卡的派发」): a P0/P1 in development holds nothing back. Against NORTH-STAR rule 3 「本车道队列还有开放的 P0/P1 时,该车道不派 p2/p3 的工具卡、契约卫生卡」: no contradiction — in the skill's own state model 队列 is the `pm:queue` label (`SKILL.md:102` 「open + 队列标签 + 无 assignee | 可派发」), and dispatch removes it in the same label write that adds `pm:dispatched` (`SKILL.md:104` 「与摘 `pm:queue` 同一次标签写入成对落地」), so a dispatched P0/P1 is no longer an item in the queue; 「开放 = 未派发」 is the state model's reading of NORTH-STAR's words, not a change to them. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is not in the diff. Every other line reading the same gate was searched at the head: `git grep -n 'P0/P1'` over `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch` hits only the three lines above (`execution-duties.md:44`, `:45`, `triage-duties.md:64`); `p0/p1` hits only the two inheritance homes; `lanes/*.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md` carry no P0/P1 gate; `SKILL.md:116` `priority:p0` row (「插队:可超 `batch`、破轮次立即派发…」) and `SKILL.md` 「优先级」 (:40–45, rule precedence) are untouched and not contradicted. On 「无 assignee」 as the second condition: it is right. The assignee is the claim marker (`SKILL.md:103` 「assignee 已设 | 已认领/在飞」; `execution-duties.md:56` 「卡 assignee 归 PM」) and `pm:dispatched` the label, written after the claim; a P0/P1 claimed but not yet labelled therefore already holds nothing back, which agrees with `SKILL.md:103` and with the candidate definition at `execution-duties.md:10` 「候选 = open、未 assign…」 — it closes the window between claim and label write rather than opening one. On a `pm:blocked` P0/P1 with no assignee: the six pm states are mutually exclusive (`SKILL.md:121`) and `pm:blocked` is 「选择期跳过」 (`SKILL.md:107`), so such a card is not in 本车道队列 and does not hold p2/p3 tooling cards back under `:44`'s scoping — the seat's own claim comment read it that way (「Lane P0/P1: none open … (#20395, #18290 are `pm:blocked`)」). The new line's parenthetical, read on its own, names two negative conditions and not the state, so a literal reader could count a blocked P0/P1 as 开放; that is not a new rule (the sentence hangs under `:44`'s 「本车道队列」 and the state model resolves it) and it is not the ruling's intent to idle a lane on a card nothing can dispatch. **Finding for the seat (non-blocking):** a later tightening of `:45` to name the queue state explicitly (7 bytes of headroom under the 120-byte budget) would close the reading; not owed by this PR.

**(c) `SKILL.md:112`** — 「四具名读者 = 候选查询排除、首触即关、舰队一张在飞、普查半态行」 becomes 「三具名读者 = 候选查询排除、首触即关、普查半态行」. Removing 舰队一张在飞 executes message 2. Of the three kept: 候选查询排除 exists (`execution-duties.md:10` 「⛔ 排除两行皆无的 `tooling` 卡」); 首触即关 exists (`triage-duties.md:63–64`); 普查半态行 does not exist anywhere at `main` or at the head. Verified: `check-half-states.mjs` — its predicate roster H1–H28 (and the later rows to H59) has no row on the `tooling` label; `git grep -n -i tooling origin/main -- scripts/pm 'scripts/*.mjs'` hits only test fixtures in `close-cards.mjs` and `sweep-stale-finding.mjs`, the ratchet's provenance comment and the `ensure-pm-labels.sh` comment; `Unblocks` appears in `check-half-states.mjs` only in fixture text (:2026, :24088); no census script (`sweep-stale-finding.mjs`, `sweep-closed-cards.mjs`, `board-snapshot.mjs`, `changeset-deadline-census.mjs`) reads the label; and the skill itself has no half-state line about a `tooling` card with neither line (`半态|半状态|两行` over the skill: none about tooling). So the governed row at the head names one reader nothing implements. This is not introduced by the PR — the row was already false at `main` by the same reader, one wider — and the card's item 2 ordered exactly this handling (「Measure the fourth reader … report it under the PR's `## Acceptance notes`; ⛔ do not widen this PR to it」), which the dev did. Not a FAIL. **Finding the seat carries** (NORTH-STAR rule 4: 「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」): either add the half-state row (a `tooling` card open in `pm:queue` carrying neither an `Unblocks: #N` line nor a named surface) to `check-half-states.mjs`, or drop 普查半态行 from `SKILL.md:112` and the matching clause at `ensure-pm-labels.sh:286–287` in one write. The dev named the seat as carrier and did not file; the seat should file or fix it in its own round.

**(d) Message 2 in full** — 「只要优先派高优先级的卡片就可以」. At the head the only sequencing of `tooling` cards is the take-order at `execution-duties.md:46–47` (取卡全序: 维护者直派插队卡, then 契约面卡, then 标签序; 标签序 `priority:p0` first, then `pm:blocking`, 功能点位次, `target:`, p1, p2, p3, 无级) — no other line caps, counts or queues a `tooling` card fleet-wide. Two conditions on `tooling` cards remain that are not sequencing and that the ruling did not name, and the record says so: the ENTRY condition — a `tooling` card enters `pm:queue` only with an `Unblocks: #N` line or a named published surface (`triage-duties.md:34`; the candidate exclusion at `execution-duties.md:10`; the label description in `ensure-pm-labels.sh:297`) — which the card's "What does not change" keeps; and the lane P0/P1 HOLD of NORTH-STAR rule 3 itself (Tier H, unchanged), now read as undispatched-only. Also noted: `SKILL.md:117` `area:*` row 「同轴至多一个在飞,除非文件面不相交」 is a per-axis in-flight cap on every card, not a tooling rule and not the retired one; leaving it is right and it is outside the ruling.

**(e) `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh:282–289`** — consistent with the new row: three consumers (candidate query, first-touch close, census/half-state patrol) and the explicit negation 「(No fleet-wide in-flight count: the take-order alone sequences tooling cards.)」. The `gh label create tooling … -d "…"` line is byte-identical to `main` (moved :296 → :297 by the comment's +1 line); `check:pm-label-desc-cap` unaffected. Comment only, verified by filtering the diff for changed non-`#` lines: none. Cosmetic: the re-wrap leaves `:289` as a short orphan (`# five-repo loop on the rule stated`); no rule. The comment's patrol clause restates the unimplemented reader of (c) — same finding, same fix.

**(f) Mechanical pins, read at the head.** Line counts `wc -l`: `SKILL.md` 319, `execution-duties.md` 183, `triage-duties.md` 120 — equal at merge-base, `main` and head; ceilings in `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` 319 (:374) / 183 (:1234) / 120 (:1233); headroom 0 each; net 0 per file. `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120` (:2251), table rows exempt but metered by the per-file pin (:2293, :2537): the changed non-table lines are 113 B (`execution-duties.md:45`) and 113 B (`triage-duties.md:64`, was 87); a scan of every non-table, non-fenced line in the three files finds none over 120 B at the head (none at `main` either). Widest `SKILL.md` table row: 342 B at L162 at both `main` and head (pin 342 at :1986, headroom 0); the edited `:112` row is 206 B (was 227). The two reference files carry pin 0 and no table row; the diff adds none. No untouched line re-wrapped: `SKILL.md` and `triage-duties.md` each show one hunk replacing one line; `execution-duties.md` shows the `:22` deletion and the one insertion after old `:45`, nothing else. The four-axis frame block (`SKILL.md` 「升级与决策」, the block at :240–260 beginning 「**每个方案必须沿四条固定评估轴分析…」) is byte-identical between `main` and head (equal sha256 for :240–260 and for the whole :211–276 section). No `#NNN` in any added line of the four files (`check:pm-skill-id-lint` pattern). `AGENTS.md` untouched (not in the diff; identical `main` vs head). `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` untouched.

**(g) Census re-run at the head** over `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `scripts/pm/**`, `scripts/*.mjs`: 一张在飞 0 · 舰队至多 0 · 第二张等 0 · `tooling slot` 0 · one `tooling` 0 · `at most one .tooling` 0 · `one-tooling` 0 · 名额 0 · 第二张 2 (both unrelated: `dispatch-runbook.md:160`, `spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md:189`; the report's 3 at the merge-base included the retired `:22`) · `in-flight count` 1 (`ensure-pm-labels.sh:288`, the negation written by this PR) · `dispatched fleet-wide` 1 and `one tooling card` 1 (both `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:346`) · `fleet-wide` 22, of which 1 on a line naming tooling (the same `:346`). The `:346–347` hit is a provenance comment inside a `CEILINGS` map entry recording what a past ruled raise (813 → 819) paid for; it narrates history, no seat reads it as a rule, and the claim allowed that file only for lowering a ceiling row — leaving it is right. No operative restatement of the retired rule survives at the head.

### ② Semver level

None. The diff touches `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and a comment in `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`; no `package.json` `files[]` in the tree names `.claude` or `scripts/pm` (the only `scripts/pm` mentions are root `scripts` entries; the root package is `private: true` with no `files[]`), so nothing published changes. `skip-changeset` on the PR is the seat's label and is right; `Check Changeset` re-ran `skipped` after it. `Clause-②: no` is right — no contract accept/reject behaviour, no public surface; the GitHub label object's description is unchanged.

### ③ Boundary flags

Every deviation the report (5921492175) declares is answered:
1. **`ensure-pm-labels.sh` edited outside the claim's named surface** (claim 5921125191: 「⛔ no other script」) but inside the card's item 4 (「Re-read `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md` and `scripts/pm/**` for any other restatement … and retire it in the same PR」). The card is the ruling's carrier and names `scripts/pm/**` and "the same PR"; the claim's surface was the seat's narrower list. A comment-only rewrite of a restated rule belongs in this PR and does not widen it: no behaviour, no description string, no label object changes (verified in ①(e)). Accepted; dropping the commit as the dev offered would leave a restatement the card ordered retired.
2. **The reading on a line of its own under old `:45`** rather than in-line: old `:45` is 111 B and the reading is 113 B on its own, so an in-line form would break the 120-byte budget; it is paid from the line `:22` freed, net 0, no re-wrap. Accepted — the card's budget rule (net ≤ 0, ⛔ no re-wrap, ⛔ no ceiling raise) is met and the sketch's "in-line" was not a rule.
3. **No ratchet row lowered.** Judged from the script: the line verdict is at-most (`lineCount` over `maxLines` reds, :2086; the headroom hint prints only above 120 lines, :2602–2603) and the row-pin verdict is at-most (`widest` over `pin` reds, :2537; any slack prints a hint, :2590–2592). All three files stand at headroom 0, so there was nothing to lower; the claim's conditional did not fire. Accepted.
4. **First commit's trailer amended before publication.** `scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs` declares the co-author value model-free (`DECLARED_COAUTHOR`, :300) and refuses an id-form model name in the pair (`MODEL_ID_FORM`, :320) at pre-push. Both published commits (`64891eb97`, `2f2869206`) carry the declared pair (the model-free co-author line and `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`) and no card trailer; the branch is those two commits, so no published history was rewritten. Accepted — the hook doing its job.
5. **Bot labels** `documentation`, `size/s`: `Auto Label` 110142822697 success at 23:22:37–23:22:53Z, the path and size labelers; not the dev's. Accepted.
6. **`mcp_calls: 0` / `api_writes: 2`** against the threads: the PR thread has zero comments; the PR object (author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, created 23:22:11Z) is write 1 (`pr_create`); the card thread has exactly two comments — the seat's claim 5921125191 (22:55:00Z) and the dev's `os-dev-report` 5921492175 (23:24:31Z), write 2. PR assignee is `os-warren`, the card's assignee and the seat's account; the `skip-changeset` label's application is bracketed by the second check suite 99648333290 at 23:27:00Z and PR `updated_at` 23:27:01Z, after the dev's report — consistent with the seat's write, not the dev's. Three `git push`es are not REST writes. Nothing in the inputs contradicts the report's counts. Accepted.

Open for the seat (not blocking this verdict): the 普查半态行 reader of ①(c)/(e), and the optional queue-state tightening of ①(b). `open_questions` in the report is empty and stays empty.
